title: F027 workflow recipe
description: skills/faion/recipes/<name>/recipe.json — the platform-neutral pipeline `faion workflow build` compiles into a Claude Dynamic Workflow and a Codex chain. It is data, never code: no conditionals, no expressions, nothing the compiler can be made to run. This schema mirrors the typed model in faion-cli internal/workflow/recipe.go; the CLI's own `faion workflow validate` remains the authority on cross-stage references, and scripts/validate-recipes.py runs it. Constraints encoded here are the shape checks that must hold with no binary present.

recipe.description: Recipe format version. The only supported value.

name.description: Names the workflow and its artifacts (.claude/workflows/<name>.js, <name>.codex.sh). Must equal the recipe directory name.

pattern.description: One named orchestration pattern per workflow. Pattern stacking is the antipattern the corpus names.

pattern_rationale.description: Why that pattern. Reproduced in every emitted artifact's header, so a reader of the artifact can challenge the choice.

vars.description: The recipe's invocation surface. Every {{var:NAME}} referenced anywhere in the recipe must be declared here, and every declared var must be documented in the card's ## Inputs.

stages.description: Stages run in array order. Array order is the DAG order: there is no forward reference and therefore no cycle to detect.

fragmentRef.description: A shipped recipe may only compose corpus fragments. A bare or user: reference resolves on the author's machine and nowhere else.

id.description: Names the stage; becomes a filename in the run dir and a slot name in later prompts.

slots.description: Values handed to frag.Compose. Keys must cover every {{slot:NAME}} the prompt fragment declares, plus those of the gate's verifier and fixer, and must not name a slot no fragment reads.

capability.description: The closed {read, write, net} model. Any other key — in any spelling of danger-full-access — is refused: the ceiling is workspace-write.

over.description: Fan-out ranges only over an earlier stage's JSON array. There is no fan-out over a var.
